content: PDF extraction for RAG: layout error cascading - small layout detection errors cause severe downstream OCR/parse failures. Multi-column layouts break reading order and produce half-sentences. Tables: merged cells, lost column headers, row-boundary errors turn answer-bearing facts into weak retrieval units; header loss hurts more than OCR character noise. Scanned docs: rotation/skew/handwriting degrade OCR; text stored as vector curves is missed entirely. Repeated headers/footers pollute every chunk. Critical: NONE of these raise exceptions - extraction returns text, embeddings compute, system answers confidently and wrongly.
